title: Government Of India Act 1935
definition: A landmark constitutional enactment by the British Parliament that provided a detailed blueprint for an All-India Federation, introduced provincial autonomy, and served as the primary structural template for the modern Constitution of India.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (factual provisions, division of subjects, bicameralism) and Mains (evolution of Indian federalism, administrative continuity, legacy in the present Constitution).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Government Of India Act 1935.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
